title: [BUG] Notebook structure CI succeeds without validating notebooks
author: dajiaohuang
body_preview: The Notebook Quality Check runs `scripts/validate_notebooks.py` without any paths. The script validates only paths passed in argv; with no arguments it prints “No notebooks to validate” and exits 0. Thus notebook pull requests pass this structural check without checking empty cells or saved error outputs. Reproduce by running `python scripts/validate_notebooks.py` from the repository root: it exit...
